changeSet.author: GA-Lotse
changeSet.sql: WITH progress_entries_to_delete as ( DELETE FROM system_progress_entry WHERE key_document_type = 'EMPLOYEE_LIST' RETURNING id) , files_to_delete as ( DELETE FROM progress_entry WHERE id in (SELECT * FROM progress_entries_to_delete) RETURNING file_id) , file_content_to_delete as ( DELETE FROM file WHERE file.id in (SELECT * FROM files_to_delete) RETURNING file_content_id) , deleted_image_meta_data as ( DELETE FROM image_meta_data WHERE image_id IN (SELECT * FROM files_to_delete) RETURNING image_id) , image_to_delete as ( DELETE FROM image WHERE id in (SELECT * FROM files_to_delete) RETURNING id) DELETE FROM file_content WHERE id in (SELECT * FROM file_content_to_delete);
